title: Oku no Hosomichi (The Narrow Road to the Deep North)

access.edition_or_version: Penguin Classics translation by Nobuyuki Yuasa, 1966 (ISBN 978-0-14-044185-7)

mechanics.reader_promise: Companionship on a long, unhurried journey; the reader is invited along as a fellow traveller.
mechanics.point_of_view: First-person travel narration in prose punctuated by haiku, moving place by place.
mechanics.psychic_distance: Close but unconfiding: the narrator shares attention, not confession, keeping the reader alongside.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Haibun (alternating prose and verse); humility and understatement; attention to ordinary way-stations, horses and inns; seasonal allusion.
mechanics.emotional_progression: Wandering without climax; each stop accrues small companionship and quiet reflection.
mechanics.tone_markers: Shared journey with a named companion, conversational travel address, ordinary concrete detail, absence of superiority.
